t: This track will launch any cart that passes over it into the air. Launch force can be adjusted by right-clicking on the rail with a Crowbar.$(br2)The track must be powered with Redstone to launch carts.
此轨道可将经过其上的任何矿车弹射至空中。弹射力度可通过撬棍右键点击轨道进行调节。$(br2)轨道必须由红石充能才能弹射矿车。
